method: 120 random valid drafts. Geometry/ratings compute each possession probability. Independent seeded uniform rolls sample the equivalent bucket/miss distribution, including pass risk. A predeclared simple play is used per opponent, not an oracle best play. This measures the model, not human enjoyment.

summary.paceEstimate: At 3.4 seconds of playback plus 6–12 seconds to decide/edit per possession, excluding drafting and tutorial.
